1. (Currently amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles having a size of 8-12 micrometers; a thermally conductive binder comprising premixed solder paste; and a solvent selected from the group consisting of ethyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol, acetone, methylethyl ketone, FC-72, or FC-87.

2. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface and the cavity-generating particles are selected from the group consisting of nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys.

3. (Original) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface.
